data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism ends with the assertion: 'Unlike every previously studied system of this kind, which faced identical structural constraints yet exhibited none of this behaviour.' This is an extraordinary universal comparative claim — it asserts something about ALL previously studied systems of 'this kind,' claims they faced IDENTICAL structural constraints, and claims NONE exhibited 'this behaviour.' The target provides zero premises, zero derivation entries, zero formalization references, and zero simulation references to support this sweeping empirical-historical statement. It is a bare, unsupported assertion that functions as load-bearing context for the 'cost' of the proposed view (implying the behaviour is uniquely problematic), yet it is presented as established fact. An ungrounded universal claim about every previously studied system cannot serve as legitimate support for the target's argument about the defensibility of a methodological preference.
